consumed.resolution: console lane cl-skills-drift-peer (fix/skills-drift-host-stamp), option A after review: skillsDriftCheckDefault always runs the worktree's own evolve skills check when the tree carries go/internal/skillcheck/ (carriesSkillsGenerator), else the in-process check with byte-identical output; this covers a base newer than the host, an imported-package change and a dirty-tree host build; the stamp-diff design (option B) was rejected; acceptance tests TestSkillsDriftGate_Cycle1841ReplayBaseNewerThanTheHostPasses, _BaseGeneratorChangeWithoutRegenerationFails, _ImportedPackageChangeIsGradedByTheWorktreeGenerator, _TreeWithoutTheGeneratorSourceIsGradedInProcess; the second half of the preventive action (classify infra-systemic over a gate-forced FAIL) is the follow-up failure-dossier-reads-no-builder-declared-system-class

fix: In skillsDriftCheckDefault, also use the worktree generator when go/internal/skillcheck/ differs between the host binary's build stamp (version.Commit) and the worktree HEAD, not only between WorktreeBaseSHA and HEAD. Pin it with a table test: (host stamp == base, lane does not touch skillcheck) -> in-process check; (host stamp older than a base that changed skillcheck) -> worktree check; (unknown stamp 'dev'/empty) -> worktree check.
notes: No pipeline-defect-* item was filed for cycle 1841 (see the follow-up failure-dossier-reads-no-builder-declared-system-class). This record files the retro lesson inst-L1841a as the tracked item and consumes it in the same lane, as #821 did for pipeline-defect-infra-systemic-cycle1840.
root_cause: skillsDriftCheckDefault (go/internal/phases/audit/skillsdrift.go:30 at 9b47ca6ae) selected the worktree generator only when the lane diff since WorktreeBaseSHA touched go/internal/skillcheck/. After the rebase onto 9b47ca6ae the base carried the generator change, so the in-process generator of the host binary (8f46ad383) graded 32 up-to-date stubs as drift.
summary: Cycle 1841 (route-verbs-refuse-mid-wave): three audits wrote PASS and the skills-drift gate forced FAIL with 32 stale commands/*.md, because the host binary was built at 8f46ad383 and the rebased base 9b47ca6ae changed the generator.
title: The skills-drift gate graded a base newer than the host build stamp with the host generator (cycle 1841, lesson inst-L1841a)
